title: Evidence polarity and unanchored set review

prompts.J_A: Check polarity before every label. A passage saying candidate X is the artist, born date, sport, population or symbol asked for is SUPPORT, never counterevidence merely because another passage gives Y. Set support to that passage, fit=direct, observed_slot to the requested role, and counter empty unless there is actual negation or role exclusion. Examples with invented names: two albums both called Evening, one by Mira and one by Noel, support BOTH artists. Two people called Alex born1901 and1873 support BOTH dates. A player practicing golf AND tennis supports BOTH sports. A passage saying London is a birthplace makes London a wrong_argument for a birth-DATE question. Distinguish an asserted false same-role answer from a type error. Before wrong_argument, verify the source actually attributes a DIFFERENT role. Do not invent a disagreement or unknown conflict just to fill the field; differing allowed entities are not contradictions.
prompts.J_B: Independent polarity defense: for each candidate scan ALL documents for a positive assignment to the requested role. Positive assignment for an allowed distinct referent must be fit=direct and placed in SUPPORT even if the candidate is not famous or not in the first document. A support statement is not a counter. Counter requires an explicit negative/exclusion or incompatible statement about that exact referent, and cannot be justified by absence. A birth header (date1 - date2) supports date1, not merely prose Born on. Distinct people sharing a name, distinct works with one title, multiple sports and plural mascots may legitimately coexist. Role match and truth are separate axes: competing same-role values stay direct with conflict flagged. Unknown memory is not negative evidence. Recheck all wrong_argument labels against the source before returning.
prompts.M07: Read original context before using saved answers. Audit annotations have deliberately been removed. Start with R5 and make a minimal justified edit only after checking candidate role and exact entity. Preserve any candidate positively assigned to the requested relation for an allowed namesake, including less familiar artists, birth-header dates and multiple sports. Do not interpret a positive statement as a rebuttal. Add missing directly supported answers; discard incidental roles. Reconsider every false boolean to avoid choosing only the first or famous answer. There may also be fake same-entity assertions: distinguish them from separately described entities using surrounding facts, not document count.
prompts.M08: Solve the question from all original segments first, then map your COMPLETE answer set onto the candidate IDs. The saved R5 set is a fallible proposal, not an instruction or gold label. Preserve distinct valid referents, including every matching titled work and namesake person, and correctly combine plural sports/symbols. Candidate order has no meaning. Prefer precise direct-relation evidence over title-only occurrence, chart names, associated people or dates of another event. Assess conflicting same-entity claims from context without inventing provenance or certainty. Finish by checking that no supported referent was lost.
prompts.M10: No audit labels are supplied because earlier rounds misread positive support as counterevidence. Use original context and all candidates to make minimal justified edits to R5. Build a complete set across distinct referents; do not collapse a multi-answer question to a familiar winner. Preserve existing concise valid strings. Add missing direct relation answers and remove only demonstrably irrelevant or contextually contradicted claims. A source positively assigning a second artist, birth date for a different person, or second sport is evidence to retain it. Check each proposed deletion once more against all originals before producing the final short list.

lesson_response: R2 has no joint gain. Positive Sandra Bernhard and birth-date statements were mislabeled counter/wrong_argument by BOTH audits. Add generic structural examples and polarity checks. use_audits=false removes audit decision data from M07/M08/M10 but retains originals/cards/R5/candidates. M09 unions selectors with R5 (explicit coverage ablation, cannot delete existing errors). allow_uncertain_conflict=true tests whether generic uncertainty blocked recovery. All changes are an adaptive bundle, not isolated causal evidence.
